texts.zh: 一艘货舱早已被遗弃在[From.GetName]的大气层上部。不知为何，这个货舱没有被其他的太空远行者发现。其轨道正在逐渐降低，预计将在几年后在气态巨行星的大气中消磨殆尽。当[Root.GetName]的船员们打开货舱后，他们发现了一大堆贵金属制作的外星珠宝。
texts.en: A discarded cargo pod was left by someone in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName] long ago. It has somehow escaped the notice of other spacefarers, and its decaying orbit means it would have been lost in the gas giant's crushing atmosphere within another few years. When the crew of the [Root.GetName] unsealed the pod, they found a stash of alien jewelry made out of precious metals.
